name: agent_bridge_status
description: Check the gateway's version, Rust backend, database schema, and active desktop profile before diagnosing a connection. Use desktop_policy_status for workspace limits and permitted file operations.

name: agent_bridge_context_create
description: Register a new actor before creating or joining a mission. Returns a public context_id for invitations and a private context_handle for subsequent calls. Keep the handle secret and reuse it; another call creates a different identity.

name: agent_bridge_mission_create
description: Start a durable mission owned by your context. Returns the mission ID, goal, status and revision. Use mission_list to find existing work. For a retry, reuse the original goal and idempotency key.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

goal.description: Work to be accomplished, written for the agents participating in this mission.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key for this operation. Reuse it only with the same arguments when retrying.

name: agent_bridge_mission_get
description: Read one mission's goal, status, revision and timestamps as an attached member. Use mission_observe to check an invitation or identify the current owner; it also works before attachment.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

name: agent_bridge_mission_observe
description: Check your invitation or membership before a handoff. Returns the mission revision, current owner's public ID, your role and attachment state. For the goal and work status, attached members can use mission_get.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

name: agent_bridge_mission_grant
description: Invite another context to an existing mission as its current owner. This records an invitation; the target must call mission_attach to join. Use the mission revision from mission_observe and reconcile an uncertain reply before retrying.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

if_revision.description: Current mission revision from mission_observe. A stale revision is rejected.

target_context_id.description: Public context_id of the other actor. A private context_handle is not accepted here.

name: agent_bridge_mission_attach
description: Accept an existing invitation as the invited context. This changes membership to attached and returns the updated mission. Check mission_observe for your invitation state and current revision before retrying.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

if_revision.description: Current mission revision from mission_observe. A stale revision is rejected.

name: agent_bridge_mission_transfer
description: Transfer ownership to a different, already attached member. This changes who can assign work or complete the mission. Check the owner and revision with mission_observe after an uncertain reply.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

if_revision.description: Current mission revision from mission_observe. A stale revision is rejected.

target_context_id.description: Public context_id of the other actor. A private context_handle is not accepted here.

name: agent_bridge_mission_list
description: Find missions to which your context is attached, most recently created first. Returns up to the requested number of mission records. For one known mission, use mission_get.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return; defaults to 20.

name: agent_bridge_mission_checkpoints
description: Read saved result summaries for a mission you have joined, newest revision first. Returns checkpoint IDs, summaries and revisions, including an empty list when none exist. To append a summary, use the singular mission_checkpoint tool.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return; defaults to 20.

name: agent_bridge_mission_checkpoint
description: Append one durable progress summary to a mission you have joined. This advances the mission revision and returns the updated mission record. For history, or to check whether a write succeeded before retrying, use the plural mission_checkpoints tool.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

summary.description: Progress or result to record for this mission.

if_revision.description: Current mission revision from mission_observe. A stale revision is rejected.

name: agent_bridge_mission_subtask_create
description: Create one unit of work inside a mission you own. Leave it unassigned or name an attached member. Returns the subtask and a replay indicator. Reuse the same key and arguments for a retry.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

goal.description: Specific assignment to create within the mission.

assignee_context_id.description: Public context_id of an attached mission member who should perform this work.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key for this operation. Reuse it only with the same arguments when retrying.

name: agent_bridge_mission_subtask_assign
description: Assign pending or blocked work to an attached member as the mission owner. Supply the subtask revision from mission_subtask_list. Returns the updated subtask and a replay indicator.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

subtask_id.description: ID of the assignment returned by mission_subtask_create or mission_subtask_list.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key for this operation. Reuse it only with the same arguments when retrying.

if_revision.description: Current revision of this subtask from mission_subtask_list, distinct from the mission revision.

assignee_context_id.description: Public context_id of an attached mission member who should perform this work.

name: agent_bridge_mission_subtask_list
description: Read a mission's assignments, progress and result summaries as an attached member. Use a subtask ID for one assignment, or page through creation order with the returned cursor.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

subtask_id.description: Return only this assignment. Omit to list the mission's assignments.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return; defaults to 20.

after_created_revision.description: Pagination cursor. Pass next_after_created_revision from the previous page to continue.

name: agent_bridge_mission_subtask_update
description: Update your assigned work using its current subtask revision. Start with in_progress, then record blocked or completed with a summary. The mission owner can also release another assignee's in-progress work as blocked. Returns the subtask and a replay indicator.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

subtask_id.description: ID of the assignment returned by mission_subtask_create or mission_subtask_list.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key for this operation. Reuse it only with the same arguments when retrying.

if_revision.description: Current revision of this subtask from mission_subtask_list, distinct from the mission revision.

status.description: Next state of this assignment. Start work with in_progress before reporting blocked or completed.

summary.description: Required for blocked or completed work. Describe the blocker, reason for release or result. Optional for in_progress.

name: agent_bridge_mission_complete
description: Close a mission you own at its current revision. This changes the mission status to completed and returns the mission record. Use mission_subtask_update to finish only one assignment; reuse the original key and arguments for a retry.

actor_context_handle.description: Private context_handle returned by agent_bridge_context_create. Authenticate as its owner; never share this value.

mission_id.description: ID of the target mission, returned by mission_create or mission_list.

if_revision.description: Current mission revision from mission_observe. A stale revision is rejected.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key for this operation. Reuse it only with the same arguments when retrying.
